extensionDescription.message: Open films on Letterboxd from Google Search and selected text.

resultSearchDescription.message: Find the film in Letterboxd search.

tokenLabel.message: Personal TMDB API Read Access Token

privacyData.message: The extension uses film details from supported Google Search pages and text you select when you use the context menu. Opening a result sends its ID, film URL or search text to Letterboxd. With TMDB enabled, the extension sends titles, years and language to TMDB when it needs to identify a film. The extension has no analytics, advertising or developer-operated server.

privacyToken.message: The TMDB token stays in trusted extension storage. It is sent in the authorization header to the TMDB API. You can remove it in advanced settings. Chrome's local storage is not an encrypted vault.

privacyCache.message: Confirmed film matches expire after 24 hours and are stored in the current browser session by default. You can opt to keep them between sessions or clear them in advanced settings.

configured.message: Token saved. Test the connection to check it.

tmdbDisabled.message: TMDB is off. The token is still saved.

rateLimited.message: TMDB rate limit reached. Try again later.

unavailable.message: Could not complete the action. Try again.

tmdbUnavailable.message: Could not connect to TMDB. Try again later.

permissionDenied.message: TMDB site permission was not granted.

enterToken.message: Enter a TMDB read access token.
